summary: Record schema versioning (V1/V2) added; V1 writes are now rejected — only V2 (with token binding) may be newly written, though V1 reads remain supported indefinitely via migrate_v1_to_v2.
migration_notes: Any integrator or off-chain indexer still writing the V1 shape (no token binding) must move to V2 before this ships to mainnet. See docs/COMPATIBILITY.md for the full read/write path and the deprecation timeline.

summary: Added the migration safety framework (dry_run, MigrationJournal, post-checks, rollback strategy) in shared::migration — opt-in tooling for future schema/data migrations, not itself a change to any existing contract's interface.

Added a deterministic lifecycle state machine (shared::lifecycle) for AidRecord/EscrowRecord/Proposal transitions. Opt-in until individual contracts are refactored onto it; no existing contract's behavior changed.

Added shared::disclosure: a builder for transaction-detail fields where a Critical field can never end up reachable only through the advanced view. Not yet used by any contract, so no interface changed.
Added this machine-readable changelog (changelog/entries.json + schema.json) and its validator, alongside the existing prose CHANGELOG.md. Does not itself change any contract's on-chain interface.
Added shared::lifecycle_events: a canonical, versioned lifecycle event envelope with schema version and resource IDs, plus an ordered-sequence assertion harness in the testing crate.
Implemented two-step ownership transfer with pending acceptance and expiry (shared::auth, contracts/access-control), preventing accidental reassignment.

Added automated Soroban CPU/memory footprint profiling in CI (profile-budget job), comparing key contract calls against a checked-in baseline and failing on a >10% regression. No contract interface change.

Added operator-safe backfill tool with dry-run diff preview, resumable checkpoints, rollback support, and detailed skipped/failed record reporting across treasury, aid, referral, governance, oracle, and marketplace modules (Issue #217).

Added data minimization review and retention enforcement for operational metadata across Treasury, Aid, Referral, Governance, Oracle, and Marketplace modules with testable two-phase deletion, hold management, and migration adapters (Issue #229).

Added release readiness gate and automated verification for migrations, security checks, smoke tests, and rollback rehearsals across Treasury, Aid, Referral, Governance, Oracle, and Marketplace modules (Issue #253).

Added shared::audit_ledger: a hash-chained, exportable audit ledger sealing every privileged and financial action-audit event, with treasury verify/export/seal entrypoints and an ("audit","aud_seal") event (Issue #233).
